title: ranunculus cuneilobus var. distrias
intro: Ranunculus cuneilobus var. distrias, commonly known as the crested buttercup, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and pain, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus cuneilobus var. distrias include reducing inflammation, fighting against infections, and exhibiting analgesic and anti-spasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
